description.narrative: The local offices of the Palme center is a vital part of our work and operations and is established in a number of countries based on a strategic decision to increase presence to meet our operational needs. The local office in South Africa supports our interventions in the region.Project OrganisationsThis is a Palme Center project.Project ObjectiveThrough this project the Palme Center has established a local office in Johannesburg, South Africa. The decision to establish a local office is based on an assessment of relevance, feasibility, organisational and programme needs, cost efficiency and added value. It is a strategic choice with the following content: 1. Access and closeness to programme partners, for dialogue and organisational support, 2. Local orientation and knowledge, including risk and security assessments, 3. Support to networks, increased stability and fostering progressive alliances, 4. External communication and advocacy, helping and raising issues of importance and current affairs, 5. Legitimacy, identity and fundraising, the presence and local knowledge provide legitimacy and credibility to analysis, testimonies and reports. The local offices are also well-positioned in relation to the international donor community.
